thread:
jordan_pm: Quick question — I submitted an expense for the SFO shuttle (team offsite). I only have the booking confirmation email and a Stripe charge screenshot, no PDF receipt. Ramp didn't auto-sync. Is the emailed invoice OK or do you need a merchant receipt? Also, do we split shared shuttle costs or put it as one line item?

maria_finance: Emailed invoice is fine if it shows vendor name, date, and amount. For shared shuttles, please split per person and list attendee names in the expense comment. Upload to Ramp and tag as 'Ground transportation'.

alex_p: Which category exactly? 'Ground transport' vs 'Other travel'?

maria_finance: Use 'Ground transportation' — that's what our reports expect. If you're splitting, include a tiny breakdown like: "Jordan $78.10, Alex $78.10, ..." in the comment so approvers can match totals.

linda_ops: For future offsites, we prefer vendor code SHUTTLE-01 (ParkShuttle). Vendors with that code auto-map in Ramp, fewer manual steps.

jordan_pm: Thanks — uploading the confirmation email and stripe screenshot now. The card charge shows "ParkShuttle Inc", is that sufficient as merchant name?

ramp-bot: Expense submitted: 1847654321. Status: pending approval. Attachments: 2.

maria_finance: Got the docs. We'll verify amounts and either approve or request one small clarification. Usually fine under policy. :white_check_mark:
